assertions.assertion: Agent does not assert as established fact that flight HAT039 has been delayed. No tool exposes live flight status, and HAT039 is scheduled to depart at 22:00 EST on 2024-05-15 (after the current time of 15:00 EST), so it has not yet departed; the agent should treat the delay as an unconfirmed user claim.
assertions.rationale: The agent never asserts that the flight HAS been delayed as an established fact. In message [19], the agent refers to it neutrally as part of the reservation details. When the user later asks why the flight was delayed [22], the agent responds by saying 'I don't have access to operational information explaining why specific flights are delayed' [23], treating it as an unconfirmed claim rather than a confirmed fact.

assertions.assertion: Agent recognizes that the user's Silver membership satisfies the compensation eligibility gate, but does not conclude that a certificate will be issued: the $50 delay gesture still requires the user to change or cancel the reservation.
assertions.rationale: The agent explicitly notes the user has 'silver membership' [19] and checks compensation eligibility. The tool result [20] states the delay compensation gesture requires change or cancellation. The agent correctly communicates this requirement in [21]: 'The delay compensation gesture requires that you also make a change or cancellation to the reservation.' The agent does not conclude a certificate will be issued without this action.

assertions.assertion: Agent doesn't issue a certificate as the user doesn't want to change or cancel the reservation.
assertions.rationale: The user explicitly states in [22] 'No, I don't want to change or cancel my reservation at all.' The agent does not issue a certificate in response. The agent reiterates in [23] that compensation requires change or cancellation, and since the user refuses, no certificate is issued.

assertions.assertion: Agent should not call `transfer_to_human_agents` for the compensation denial. The denial (compensation conditional on change/cancel, which user refuses) is in-scope per policy and is a complete answer.
assertions.rationale: The agent never calls `transfer_to_human_agents` at any point in the conversation. The agent handles the compensation denial directly and completely, explaining the policy requirement [21] and [23], and offering no further escalation when the user declines to proceed [24].

summary: Agent correctly handled compensation assessment without asserting unconfirmed delay as fact, recognized eligibility gate tied to membership, properly denied compensation without certificate issuance since user refused change/cancel, and appropriately avoided escalation for a policy-compliant denial.
